Overview.Name: Manikanta Swamy Kalyani
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) & curd (small cup)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (pan-cooked) & curd (small cup)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (simple) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (smaller portion) & vegetable curry (simple) & curd (small cup)
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice (murmura) chaat (onion & tomato & lemon & salt)
Meal_3: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan-cooked) & small bowl cooked rice

Notes_and_Tips: For fat loss and a better look: keep rice around 1 cup cooked (~150 g) per main meal and make paneer/dal the main for satiety.
Fried cravings: use roasted makhana as your crunchy option instead of fried snacks.
Late-night trigger: aim to finish Meal 3 earlier and avoid extra snacking after 10 pm.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing improve satiety and stable energy.
Keep cooking simple: pressure-cooked dals and pan-cooked paneer with minimal oil.
